svg.text: Layer 1: conv, 3 taps 2 apart, 8→8, ReLU, + input
Layer 2: conv, 3 taps 4 apart, 8→8, ReLU, + input
Layer 3: conv, 3 taps 8 apart, 8→8, ReLU, + input
Layer 4: conv, 3 taps 16 apart, 8→8, ReLU, + input
← receptive field 63 steps x 10 ms = 0.63 s →
TCN: ONE OUTPUT AND EVERY INPUT IT DEPENDS ON
Right: one dot per 10 ms step and layer; time runs left to right
Blue dots: values the current output depends on; grey: not used
Lines: the 3 taps of each convolution, d steps apart (d = 1 to 16)
